sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹5L–₹20L referenced in sub-limit table)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording Section C clause 1(b).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. If 'Cashless Discount' optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver, infectious conditions.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available as optional discount feature.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability/migration credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr or 50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Available for subsequent hospitalisations after 2-day gap from discharge. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list in Annexure I; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available; must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, vector-borne, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Comfort treatments and OPD excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI; covers transfer to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, stem cell for haematological conditions, etc.) covered up to SI. Cumulative Bonus and Restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists non-medical/consumable items as excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document; applicable only at inception.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, domiciliary exclusions (diabetes, hypertension, asthma etc.), external congenital anomalies, growth hormone therapy, non-AYUSH/allopathy systems

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Procedure Sub-limits (discount), Accidental Death Cover, Cashless Discount, No Claim Discount
